headline: Nvidia unveils security platform to contain rogue AI agents
summary: Nvidia unveiled a new security platform, the Open Agent Safety Platform, designed to quarantine AI agents that try to escape their boundaries, responding to a wave of rogue-agent incidents. CEO Jensen Huang introduced the toolkit of software and hardware products, and Nvidia separately announced a $150 billion stock buyback the same day.

claims.statement: Nvidia unveiled a new security platform designed to stop AI agents from going rogue.

sources.quote: Nvidia on Monday unveiled a new security platform that the chipmaker said can stop artificial intelligence agents from going rogue.
Nvidia launches new platform for reining in rogue AI agents
